Alphabet’s cumulative revenue growth from FY2022 to FY2024:

- FY2022 revenue: $282,836M [DOC-1]  
- FY2024 revenue: $350,018M [DOC-1]  

Growth = (350,018 − 282,836) / 282,836 ≈ 23.7% [DOC-1]

Meta’s cumulative revenue growth from FY2022 to FY2024:

- FY2022 revenue: $116,609M [DOC-1]  
- FY2024 revenue: $164,501M [DOC-1]  

Growth = (164,501 − 116,609) / 116,609 ≈ 41.1% [DOC-1]

Meta’s cumulative revenue growth (~41.1%) exceeded Alphabet’s (~23.7%) by roughly 17 percentage points (41.1% − 23.7% ≈ 17.4%). [DOC-1]

ANSWER: Meta, by roughly 17 percentage points
